description.value: You read pre-Cinder arcane texts the way scholars read dead languages — which, functionally, they are. You can Decipher Writing on arcane texts written before the Turning without the normal time penalty for an unfamiliar tradition, and a failure never turns into a critical failure.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 'a failure never turns into a critical failure' clause is real (AdjustDegreeOfSuccess, matching the confirmed shape from pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-2/magical-shorthand.json's selector:'skill-check' + action predicate). The 'without the normal time penalty for an unfamiliar tradition' clause has no hook -- time-penalty removal for a skill action is never rule-element-encoded in real pf2e (e.g. Hobnobber and Forensic Acumen both leave their own time-halving unencoded).
